text:
anya: Heads-up — after bring-up of tengu-1.2 with the new int4 quant profile I see a consistent BLEU drop on zh->en. Not on all examples, seems concentrated where CJK chars sit next to latin punctuation or RTL inserts (embedding tests).
li: reprod locally — ran the wmt-small quick eval, same ~3.9 BLEU delta vs fp16 baseline. dropping tokens look like merged punctuation or missing ZWJ.
samir: can you paste a minimal example? token ids and outputs pls.
anya: minimal repro below. original (fp16):
```
zh: 这是一个测试，contains English words.
en (gold): This is a test, contains English words.
fp16 out: This is a test, contains English words.
int4 out: This is a testcontains English words.
```
notice the missing comma + space after fullwidth comma -> `test,` became `test` merged with next token. also some cases drop U+200D in mixed emoji sequences.
marta: interesting — sounds like a detokenization / decode path issue after quantization-induced subtoken shifts rather than model hallucination. did you compare tokenization traces?
anya: yes — tokenization step produced identical subtokens for this example, but after model decode the boundary token id sequence differs by one id in the middle. i attached the 2-line dump to the eval job logs.
li: i pulled logs: model logits around step 12 look noisier in int4, but the tokenizer postprocessing uses a fallback `legacy_detok` in the int4 path (we added as compatibility). hypothesis: legacy_detok treats fullwidth punct differently -> merge.
samir: quick test: run python infra/eval/run_sample.py --model tengu-1.2:int4 --input "这是一个测试，contains English words." --dump-tokens > /tmp/tok.txt and compare with :fp16. i'll run now.
ken: also saw similar low-frequency RTL cases in en->ar mixed examples where punctuation jumps side. might be same root cause (detok fallback).
eval-runner: CI quick-run completed: wmt-small zh->en 200 samples — fp16 BLEU 27.6, int4 BLEU 23.7, high confidence on diff. job: https://ci.internal/runs/98765
marta: plan: 1) confirm whether kernel quantization changed logits distribution (li). 2) run tokenizer-only AB test: replace legacy_detok with canonical detok in int4 path and rerun samples (samir). 3) if confirmed, rollback int4 detok change in Dedicated pools and gate the profile. 4) add regression alert + add failing cases to locale-specific eval set.
li: started kernel-level compare. using /opt/models/tengu/1.2/commits/0a1b2c3 vs 0a1b2c4 (quant tweak). hooking perf counters now.
anya: also adding a pair of failing examples to the multilingual-regressions suite under zh-en/bidi-punct.json
samir: quick patch to force canonical detok in int4 path pushed to review: https://ph.internal/r/4201 — if CI agrees i'll merge and trigger canary rollout to staging.
marta: +1 to canary. Ken, can you run the larger 2k-sample eval in Dedicated after the patch? need signal for rollback decision.
ken: scheduled. will run against staging pool and post results here. ETA ~45m.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for tengu-1.2:int4 to staging (pool-staging-a). monitor: https://console.internal/rollouts/roll_789
anya: thanks. adding notes to the bring-up doc (docs/bringups/tengu-1.2.md) and tagging product for visibility. if anyone sees other language combos (ja/en, ko/en, ar/en) with similar pattern please paste examples here. :pray:
li: found small numeric diff in softmax tails when quant kernel uses fused exp approximation. might explain token shift. adding micro-test to repro distribution shift.
samir: if kernel is the cause we'll need a new quant kernel release. keep rollback on table until we have passing regression set.
anya: agree. will keep thread updated.
